156000101

Characters With Break Skills Use these types of skills when an enemy has charged up their incarnate.

156000201

Characters With Charge Skills Use these types of skills when you're low on incarnate. But be careful, you can't charge up your incarnate when doing a switch combination.

156000301

Allows a character to be able to deal an additional attack when in enhance mode. Additional attacks will increase your BREAK and CHARGE amounts, putting you in a strategic advantage.

156000302

Greatly increases how powerful a skill is when in enhance mode.

156000303

Greatly increases BREAK amount when in enhance mode.

156000304

Greatly increases CHARGE amount when in enhance mode.

156000305

Enhance Mode Skills With Recovery Effect Being able to attack and heal at the same time might save you from using your healer.

156000306

Adds a buff effect to the skill when in enhance mode.

156000307

Adds an additional effect to the skill when in enhance mode.

156000308

Regular skills will change when entering enhance mode, but a special transition will also occur.

156000401

Characters With Multi-Target Attacks Multi-target attacks are very effective in battles that involve multiple enemies such as Ordinal battle or multi-target battles.

156000501

Characters With Recollection Field +1 Skills Use these skills when your RF has been lowered to keep your advantage in battle.

156000502

Characters With Recollection Field +2 Skills Use these skills when your RF has been lowered to keep your advantage in battle.

156000503

Characters With Recollection Field +3 Skills Use these skills at the start of a battle or when your RF has been greatly reduced to put you at big advantage.

156000601

Physical Attack Characters Effective against enemies that use magic res. buffs as well as enemies with resistance against magic attacks.

156000701

Magic Attack Characters Effective against enemies that use physical res. buffs as well as enemies with resistance against physical attacks.

156000801

Non-Elemental Characters Effective against non-elemental enemies.

156000901

Fire-Elemental Characters Effective against wind-elemental enemies.

156001001

Earth-Elemental Characters Effective against water-elemental enemies.

156001101

Wind-Elemental Characters Effective against earth-elemental enemies.

156001201

Water-Elemental Characters Effective against fire-elemental enemies.

156001301

Light-Elemental Characters Effective against dark-elemental enemies.

156001401

Dark-Elemental Characters Effective against light-elemental enemies.

156010101

Physical attacks can get stronger with an ATK buff.

156010102

Physical attacks can gradually get stronger with an ATK buff. Stack up your buff effects and release powerful attacks from the middle phase of a fight.

156010201

Magic attacks can get stronger with a MATK buff.

156010202

Magic attacks can gradually get stronger with a MATK buff. Stack up your buff effects and release powerful attacks from the middle phase of a fight.

156010301

Damage from critical strikes is increased with a critical damage buff.

156010302

Damage from critical strikes is increased incrementally with a critical damage buff. Stack up your buff effects and release powerful attacks from the middle phase of a fight.

156010401

DEF buffs or physical resistance can make characters stronger against physical attacks. These kind of debuffs are great for when your party finds itself going up against an enemy with powerful physical attacks.

156010402

DEF buffs or physical resistance can make characters incrementally stronger against physical attacks. Stacking up your buff effects and lowering the amount of heals you need from the middle phase of a fight can open up an enemy's flank to squeeze an attack in.

156010501

MDEF buffs or magic resistance can make characters stronger against magic attacks. These kind of debuffs are great for when your party finds itself going up against an enemy with powerful magic attacks.

156010502

MDEF debuffs or magic resistance can make enemies incrementally weaker against magic attacks. Stacking up your buff effects and lowering the amount of heals you need from the middle phase of a fight can open up an enemy's flank to squeeze an attack in.

156010601

Elemental buffs can strengthen a character against specific elemental attacks. These kind of debuffs are great for when your party finds itself going up against an enemy with powerful attacks.

156010701

Charge buffs can increase the charge amount of a character. You can get effects that are equal to more than one C-skill so use them as much as you can. They don't go away during switch combinations so strategize and use them to great effect.

156010801

Break buffs can increase the break amount of a character. You can get effects that are equal to more than one B-skill so use them as much as you can. They don't go away during switch combinations so strategize and use them to great effect.

156010901

Evasion rate can be raised with an evasion buff.

156011001

Evasion rate against physical attacks can be raised with an evasion buff.

156011101

Evasion rate against magic attacks can be raised with an evasion buff.

156020101

Enemy physical attacks can be mitigated with an ATK debuff. These kind of debuffs are great for when your party finds itself going up against an enemy with powerful physical attacks.

156020102

Enemy physical attacks can incrementally be mitigated with an ATK debuff. Stacking up your debuff effects and lowering the amount of heals you need from the middle phase of a fight can open up an enemy's flank to squeeze an attack in.

156020201

Enemy magic attacks can be mitigated with an MATK debuff. These kind of debuffs are great for when your party finds itself going up against an enemy with powerful magic attacks.

156020202

Enemy magic attacks can incrementally be mitigated with a MATK debuff. Stacking up your debuff effects and lowering the amount of heals you need from the middle phase of a fight can open up an enemy's flank to squeeze an attack in.

156020301

DEF debuffs or physical resistance can make enemies weaker against physical attacks. They can be used to great effect, especially when used directly before an incarnate skill and switch combinations.

156020302

DEF debuffs or physical resistance can make enemies incrementally weaker against physical attacks. Stack up your debuff effects and release powerful attacks from the middle phase of a fight.

156020401

MDEF debuffs or magic resistance can make enemies weaker against magic attacks. They can be used to great effect, especially when used directly before an incarnate skill and switch combinations.

156020402

MDEF debuffs or magic resistance can make enemies incrementally weaker against magic attacks. Stack up your debuff effects and release powerful attacks from the middle phase of a fight.

156020501

Elemental debuffs can weaken an enemy's specified elemental attacks. They can be used to great effect, especially when used directly before an incarnate skill and switch combinations.

156020601

Enemy charge amounts can be mitigated with a charge debuff. Using this debuff before an enemy gets the chance to charge will reduce their charge amount and make them more susceptible to break skills.

156020701

Enemy break amounts can be mitigated with a break debuff. They can be used to make it easier to charge up your incarnate by a significant amount, especially when used on a high difficulty enemy.

156030101

This deals continuous damage of a specified element against an enemy. Use this in combination with skills that deal additional damage against enemies inflicted with continuous damage and increased damage for continuous damage.

156030201

This totals up all continuous damage of a specified element and deals damage against an enemy. Use this in combination with skills that deal additional damage against enemies inflicted with continuous damage and increased damage for continuous damage.

156030301

This can gather up enemy targets.

156030401

This counters against enemy attacks that meet conditions.

156030701

This can recover characters who are sealed.

156030801

This can recover characters who are stunned.

156030901

This can recover characters who are knockbacked.

156031001

This can recover damage received from continuous damage attacks of a specific element.

156040101

Increases damage against enemies hit with continuous damage.

156040201

Increases damage against enemies who are inflicted with a physical res. or magic res. debuff.

156040301

Increases damage when the recollection field of a specified element is step 3 or more.

156040401

Increases damage when a specific buff is active.

156040501

Increases damage when there are multiple enemy targets. Multi-target attacks are very effective in battles that involve multiple enemies such as Ordinal battle or multi-target battles.

156040601

Increases damage when an enemy's incarnate is more than its regular amount.

156040701

Increases damage against enemies who are inflicted with an elemental res. debuff.

156050101

Heals all party members.

156050102

Recovers all party members, including reserve characters.

156050301

Recovers MP

character.administrator_cathedral

At the highest floor of the Cathedral, the High Pontifex of the Axiom Church, the Administrator, lies on her canopy bed. "If I am loved, then I will love accordingly." She demands intense devotion, and to remain young and beautiful for all eternity. Issuing out the Taboo Index, she arrests any individual who dares to try and bring about change in her Human Empire. She extracts the memories of those whom she loves the most to create her loyal Integrity Knights.

character.administrator_cathedral_2021_may

How much time had passed? The the red flickers of a light caught in the wind illuminated her Eminence's porcelain skin. She was smiling, but her eyes were not. She was bored. I traced her form with my gaze in what seemed like a moment of eternity. She didn't even bat an eye. Perhaps she will be lenient? I became lost in thought, and in that moment I sighed, completely forgetting myself in the moment.

character.administrator_cathedral_al

Eternal beauty...how boring. Listening to the sounds of water drops falling, she finally can relax and wash all these thoughts away. Cracks of light illuminated her skin while her wet hair accentuated her undeniable beauty. She stretched out her elegant legs from the snow white bathtub as the fragrance of flowers wrapped itself around her aura. Through the thin screen of steam, her allure entices.

character.administrator_cathedral_enhance

Leader of the Human Empire and High Pontifex of the Axiom Church. In a desire to stagnate the world, she created and adopted the Taboo Index into the Human Empire, which listed all laws and rules that govern the land. For the Elite Noblemen who were given overwhelming authority, she allowed them to live a lazy yet tyrannical existence. However, the lone Irregular Unit with his sharpened sword will be at her throat soon enough to end this absurdity, once and for all.

character.administrator_christmas

My memories disappeared to make room for souls. Despite having no sentiments nor attachments, it's not the worse fate that could have befallen me. Whether those memories were precious or cruel, it didn't matter. Because the past will never change. And the same goes for the future: if everything was fixed in place, then nothing will ever change.

character.administrator_naked_2021_aug

Whether it be man, beast, tree, flower, or any sort of unsightly being from the Dark Territory, all too can become equally beautiful if they were transformed into gems. That’s all life is. There is one key difference between the luster of gems and the virality of living beings. Unlike life, gems can maintain it’s beauty for all eternity. If only everything in this world could become a gem...

character.agil_sao_5

A SAO player. He's a merchant who owns a shop in the city of Algade on the 50th floor of Aincrad, and is friends with Kirito. He's also a skilled axe user, and will sometimes abandon his shop to go and fight on the front line. He appears greedy and profit-driven, but in fact invests the majority of the earnings from his business into helping mid-level players to level up.

character.airy_al

Does the sky end? How far does it go on for? Staring back from the tiny window of the Cathedral, she stared up towards the sky and pondered these very questions. "What would it feel like to fly through the sky in this floating platform?" To fly with no limits, endlessly...

character.airy_cathedral

The "Operator" who is responsible for the floating platform that goes up past the 50th floor of the Central Cathedral in Underworld. Like Integrity Knights, her Calling has been frozen, and she has continued to operate the platform, using the Sacred Arts, for 107 long years. This near-eternity of solitude has caused her to forget even her own name. She tells Eugeo that if released from her Calling she would like to fly freely through the sky.

character.alice_2022_wedding

[Bride Alice] by Ai Kayano

character.alice_2022_whiteday

Upon sniffing the sweet sweet scents coming from the snacks, I woke up. The snacks that I found around me shimmered like gemstones - just eating one of these is sure to fill my mouth with glee. Surely this all must be a dream...or perhaps its a gift from you-know-who... Just thinking of this makes me blush.

character.alice_alo

The sun shown bright in the dew of the flowers as a breeze danced playfully through her hair. Alice again found herself in unfamiliar surroundings. Yet it was still different than the real world. Tracing out the mountains in the distance, a sense of nostalgia overcame her. She gazed up at the sky and laughed. There was nothing to be afraid of, Alice is Alice wherever she may be.

character.alice_cathedral_room

Maintaining order and tranquility within the Human Empire. Alice never once questioned this heavy responsibility that was bestowed upon her from the Integrity Knights. But upon seeing the suffering that those around her were going through, she was conflicted weather to extend a helping hand. "If only I had chanted a couple of lines from the manual, maybe even that kid's life..."Before she could think any more, Alice stopped herself mid-thought. Dwelling too much on these sort of matters are beneath that of an Integrity Knight.

character.alice_child

A resident of Rulid Village in Underworld. The daughter of the village elder and childhood friend of Kirito and Eugeo. 8 years ago, when she went to the End Mountains to collect ice, she violated the Taboo Index by entering the Dark Territory to help a fallen Dark Knight. Arrested by the Integrity Knight Deusolbert, she was taken to the Cathedral.

character.alice_halloween

Limited Edition Spooky Halloween Night Scout Illustration

character.alice_inc_dress

An undyed skirt in a blue hue reminiscent of autumn skies—that is the sort of thing that Alice Zuberg would have worn if she had grown up peacefully in Rulid Village. However, that future was not to be, as she was bound to become an Integrity Knight. "I cursed my fate, but Kirito taught me what I could and should do. I won't hesitate anymore. I swear to return to the world I love".

character.alice_integrator

Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Clad in golden armor, she appears at the Swordcraft Academy to take away Kirito and Eugeo after they violate the Taboo Index. Although now dressed differently, her face and golden hair are unmistakably those of Eugeo's childhood friend Alice Zuberg, but she acts as if she is a different person.

character.alice_integrator_2nd

Alice in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. As you were always there for us, we will continue to be there for you. Always and forever.

character.alice_integrator_2021_may

Alice gently caught a soft ball of light that had dropped from the skies. Within that light, the baby dragons, Amayori and Takigur gazed upon Alice in their newborn innocence. Their warmth radiated hope from deep within her.

character.alice_integrator_al

Alice's body and soul grew tired as she fought off one red soldier after another. Her conscious begins wearing off as she continued fighting off enemy swordsmen who didn't value their own lives—for a moment, it seemed that she herself would succumb to fleeing the battle lines. But she stood her grounds—strengthened by her resolve to protect those who are special to her in this world. Chanting a spell and concentrating all of her consciousness towards her fingers, Alice releases a flame spear. "Discharge"!

character.alice_integrator_enhance

Building a house nearby Rulid Village, Alice made a living while looking after the unconscious Kirito. However, due to the incident that had happened at the village, Alice awakened to her duty of protecting the people of the Human Empire, and resolves to confront the Army of Darkness. Bidding farewell to their lonely but peaceful days, Alice returns to battle with the Osmanthus on her side!

character.alice_integrator_init

As the day winds down in the Rose Garden of the Cathedral, Alice found solace reading the book in front of her. Although she had just returned from a far away mission, she didn't have any immediate plans to get to. She could finally take a break from it all. Choosing from the Axiom Church's extensive library, she borrowed countless books that she has been wanting to read. Nestled next to the light coming from a lamp, listening to the sounds of the water fountain in the evening, Alice's exhaustion went away as she began to read.

character.alice_integrator_kizuna

Only two heretics bore witness to the death of the ruler of this world. A couple of months after, Alice was able to enjoy tranquil days with the heretic Kirito for a time. Even with no memories of her own nor the acceptance of the hometown she loves, Alice embraces the gentle warmth she bears inside of her. If only this peace could continue on for just even one more second. Dreaming from a lofty northern peak, Alice continues to pray for this.

character.alice_integrator_sorceress

Upon knowing that Dark God Vecta's target was the Priestess of Light, meaning Alice herself, Alice decides to move southward, using herself as a decoy in order to divide the enemy forces. Something surely must be there... "Take Alice and go to the World End Altar!" Alice remembers these words whom someone had said; just before Kirito had lost consciousness.

character.alice_integrator_wounded

Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. After the Administrator’s death, she became a criminal for violating the Taboo Index, she stayed with Kirito, who had lost his soul, in a hut near Rulid Village . When the forces of the Dark Territory invaded, it was her duty as an Integrity Knight to pick up her sword again to protect the Human Empire.

character.alice_real_party

Alice wondered what was the point of having a banquet like this. The rude look on the people from the real world pierced her steel body, leaving a sense of unease sink into her. Everything around her felt fictitious and unreal. Perhaps the only thing in common between their two worlds was the soft moonlight.

character.alice_swimsuit

Alice dived into the middle of the lake, where a beautiful scenery awaited her. Seeing fish swimming among the seaweeds, she could feel the divine prominence of her surroundings. Feeling immersed with this scenery, Alice continues to hold her breath as she stared into every crevice of the lake bottom.

character.alice_uw_2022_new_year

The morning sun rose over the snowfield and in that instant, the whole horizon seemingly disappeared, with nothing but endless white ahead. It's during these moments that I love the most. Though I may disappear like the snow around me, that's what makes it ever more special.

character.alice_uw_bath

Nervously, Alice dips her toes into the clear waters of the bath. Up until this point she always made an excuse to not go, but today Eydis managed to drag her into the Great Bath. Though it is just among girls, Alice feels embarrassed being exposed without her armor, and felt Eydis's gaze that seemed to contain some expectations. With her face blushing for reasons other than the temperatures of the bath, Alice hopes that no one notices.

character.alice_uw_easy

Alice Synthesis Thirty, the 30th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Knowing that the forces from the dark territory desire the so called "Priestess of Light", decides to act as a decoy in order to put distance between the enemies and Human Empire. That night, the "Goddess of Creation Stacia" confirms the relationship between Asuna and Kirito while Alice suggests a deal to Asuna visiting the tent where he is getting treated.

character.alicia_alo

An ALO player. She plays the beautiful Lord of the Cait Sith, a race with cat-like ears and tails who are adept at using the Taming skill to control monsters and animals. She's extremely popular with her people, and has held power for even longer than Sakuya has. Her ace-in-the-hole is a combat force known as the Cait Sith Dragoons, who have never even been captured in a screenshot.

character.anna_alo

I finally get it. This is the world where I'm always at. The characters and enemies are so real...not to mention the play style is completely different. But it's just the same as being inside a really fun game! The only difference being is that my friends are nearby...like on a different level!

character.argo_sao

A SAO player. She's Aincrad's number one information dealer, and is commonly known as "Argo the Rat." She'll sell any and all information that she can, and people say that if you spend just 5 minutes chatting with her she'll manage to wheedle 100 Cors' worth of information out of you. She used her experience as a beta tester to publish the "Strategy Guide by Area" on the first floor, which has helped out many players.

character.argo_sao_claw

A girl who was an informant in the VRMMORPG turned death game, SAO. The type of info she possesses is vast - ranging from anywhere from food to boss strategies. "For an informant, it's a disgrace to get only info from listening." Though she had her worries for the rash Kirito, she doesn't mind doing even boss reconnaissance by herself as long as she can get hidden info. Armed with her adept martial arts skills and quickness, she gathers up info on boss strategies to create a SAO strategy guide.

character.asuna_after_mc

Wherever it may be, my place in this world is wherever Kirito is. Knowing how hard he works, he always has a place to rest besides me.

character.asuna_alo

In order to obtain the legendary weapon "Holy Sword Excalibur", Asuna takes on a dangerous quest with her close party members. Whether it is healing her party members against Powerful Enemies or Cold Res. for the freezing plains of Jötunheimr, Asuna is well skilled in Magic skills in ALO. She will do whatever it takes to get the "Holy Sword Excalibur".

character.asuna_alo_2022_swim

You know, it's quite peaceful sitting down after a long day together. I wonder if it's because we were out in the sunlight this whole time? But no worries, as long as I can feel you here, that's the only thing that matters in right now.

character.asuna_alo_aprilfool

This world is peaceful and beautiful, making every day more enjoyable than the last. But that all came to an abrupt end when the wicked Demon King snatched me away. Trapped and isolated, the only thing I could do was pray... Pray for a hero to appear and mend the Demon King. Because deep down, even beneath all his wickedness, there still some good left in him.

character.asuna_alo_idol

It was a weird mix of feelings; embarrassing, yet elating. When you sing your heart out, your body gets electrified with excited. But the one caveat being that whenever I looked over at the seats, even for just a moment, embarrassment enveloped me and I just wanted to disappear right there and then. Afterall, it's rare for me to sing in front an audience, let along anybody for that matter.

character.asuna_alo_piece

Yuuki, "The Absolute Sword", a duelist in ALO. Asuna had challenged this swordsman to a duel, a formidable opponent who bested even Kirito. However, at the end of the duel, an unexpected outcome had happened. Yuuki's plan was to take down the Floor Boss with her guild, the Sleeping Knights, and to have their names engraved on the Monument of Swordsman. Welcomed into their guild as a supporter, Asuna resolves to conquer the Floor Boss.

character.asuna_alo_swim

Wow! The ocean is so beautiful... Whenever Asuna would go to the beach, she would toss away her sandals and walk the rest of the way. Feeling the heat from the sand underneath her feet, the wide open expanse of the ocean in front of her were beyond her expectations. "Swimming with the fishes has been my dream ever since I was little!" Asuna exclaimed. Unable to contain her excitement, Asuna jumps into the emerald green sea to be with the tropical fish.

character.asuna_alo_titania_em

Asuna shifted her eyes away as if hiding from the light. Though she had an escape plan and kept her cool, her anxiety crept forward as time passed by. This turned into fear as she caught herself staring idly into the far off distance. Even though she vowed to carry these heavy feelings, they all slowly faded away with time. A heart of ice left in their wake.

character.asuna_alo_wedding

A wave of embarrassment overcame Asuna as she donned her dress once more. Although nothing should have changed for neither of them, there was just something different about her. And there was something different about him. Just by looking at his face, it was obvious. The embarrassment quickly dissipated at this realization. Afterall, that's why they fell for each other.

character.asuna_mc

Asuna stayed behind in Underworld with Kirito. Having already maxed out her cooking skills in SAO, Asuna was interested in dishes from this world as well. Spending time in the kitchen, Asuna studied new cooking methods while getting valuable advice from the former cook of the High Pontifex, Hana. Something sure smells delicious...

character.asuna_mc_2021_may

Asuna glanced at the sun drenched world around her as she was saddled on top of her horse. Her eyes met with those of the people surrounding her, as the winds carried with them the laughter from the crowds and the rustle of the trees. Whenever she sees the denizens of Underworld living like this, Asuna swears to herself to grow in order to protect the people of this world.

character.asuna_os

Formerly distancing themselves from VR, Asuna as well as Lisbeth and Silica enjoy themselves in the very popular ARMMORG Ordinal Scale. However, to protect Silica from the SAO boss monster who cornered her, Asuna confronts the boss who conjures up fears from her time in SAO.

character.asuna_sao

A SAO player. She's a rapier user, and her speed and accuracy with a sword have earned her the alias "The Flash." She stands out from the other players in terms of both looks and sword skills, and despite her sweet appearance is sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood, the most powerful guild in the game. When not honing her combat skills, she uses her spare time to fully complete the Cooking skill.

character.asuna_sao_2_al

The girl who was imprisoned in the death game that was SAO—Asuna. "I want to be me until the very last moment... No matter what, I don't want to lose in this game... No, this world." With that thinking, she fought her way through the labyrinth where she met Kirito. "That was a little bit overkill back there." Kirito comments. Afterwards, Asuna forms a party with Kirito for the first time and conquered the boss of the first floor. By fighting with Kirito, it was the first time that Asuna discovered her goals in this world...and who she wants to follow.

character.asuna_sao_2nd_anniv

Asuna in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for always being there for us! Here's to more stories together!

character.asuna_sao_5

A SAO player. She plays a rapier user, and commands her comrades from the front line as sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood, the most powerful guild in the game. She is renowned as a top-class swordswoman, and as well as being one of the few females in Aincrad, is also extremely beautiful, making her even more of an oddity. Determined to escape from this virtual world, she puts everything she has into trying to beat the game.

character.asuna_sao_2021_sep

Slowly but surely, I could see the end to the floor. All I needed now was the hint to beat the boss which I could get from a quest. But surely that one player in black must already know that hint. That's why today I've decided to seek him out and wring the info out of him. But something tells me that he won't do so without a fight, that's for sure...

character.asuna_sao_couple

Of course forming a party together was for strategic purposes, but Asuna would be lying if she said it wasn't fun being in a party where it's just the two of them. Nestled in the basket were handmade sandwiches that Asuna had prepared. Seeing him stuff his face with the bread is a sight that she could never forget. "With a reaction like that, I should cook even more for him!"

character.asuna_sao_progre_1st_black

It's morning. Even as I awoke from my drowsiness, I still found myself in the same game from the night before. It's not a dream, but a nightmare...no, this was worse than that; this was my new reality. But I can't just sit back and wait for death to take me. I will press forward with own will and fight on. And even if I fail...that is still a far better fate than not trying at all.

character.asuna_sao_recollection

This is the Knights of the Blood, the Assault Team leading the charge at the very edge of the front lines. Being the sub-leader of the most powerful guild in the game, it is here that Asuna honed her skills with a rapier and in leadership. However, what truly drove Asuna to attack was her firm conviction to "be herself until the very end". In a world where elite titles don't matter, Asuna keeps running in order to find herself

character.asuna_sao_wasureji

Treading through the elite course, Asuna stood up to the depths of despair which was being imprisoned in SAO. Asking herself why she reached out for this game in the first place. Ever since the time when only regret filled memories plagued her, Asuna discovered the true meaning of the world that was tucked away. The time of spending days with the love of her life were beginning to come to shape for Asuna.

character.asuna_saop_2022_movie

It still scares me to cross swords with another person. But sparring with Mito is just as fun as it is scary. It reminds me of when we used to play fighting games together on the school roof. Mito and I have changed a lot since then. Even then, I believe that some things never change.

character.asuna_stacia

Asuna descends into the Underworld using the super account, "Creation Goddess Stacia". Wishing to save the world that Kirito tried to protect and meet her lover, Asuna decides to do a full drive from the Soul Translator #5. She swears to herself that for him, she will do any crime and take any punishment. Whatever it takes.

character.asuna_stacia_enhance

Using the God of Creation Stacia super account, Asuna logs into Underworld to meet Kirito. Witnessing the foreign players who have logged on into Underworld battle against the Human Empire's army and the people who are trying to protect Kirito, Asuna breathes in new life as she is reborn in Underworld.

character.asuna_stacia_place

As UW falls into crisis, Asuna logs in with the Rath super account to save her true love —Kirito. The account allows Asuna to become the Goddess of Creation Stacia, who is worshiped by the inhabitants of UW. Wielding the divine weapon, Radiant Light, along with her administrative access, she can open up cracks in the world to swallow up her enemies.

character.asuna_stacia_reward

Standing in the battlefield, Asuna observes the critical situation she finds herself in. Despite the countless number of enemies she's taken down, the enemy army continues to advance. But despite the odds, she will continue to protect this world instead of Kirito. With an unbreakable will, Alice continues her assault against the enemy.

character.asuna_uw_easy

Asuna dives into the Underworld using the super account, "Creation Goddess Stacia". On the night that Asuna and the Human Empire army promised to fight together, Alice waits in front of Kirito's tent to offer exchanging information relating to Kirito. In that deal, Asuna as well as Ronie and Sortiliena will join in the fight. The girls then reminisce over their indomitable love of Kirito since their days in SAO.

character.azurica_trainer

The supervisor of the Novice Trainee's dorm at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She was once the First Sword of the North Empire, and was awarded the title of first-rank noble after ranking highly in the Four Empire Unification Tournament. Her casting speed far exceeds that of the academy's Sacred Arts teacher, and she goes against the Taboo Index by healing Eugeo's eye. She acts as if she understands the truth about Underworld to some extent.

character.bercouli_integrator_armor

Knight Commander Bercouli Synthesis One. After the death of the Administrator, the Human Empire began mobilizing it's forces against the invasion from the Dark Territory. Nestled beneath his busy days as a defender of the Human Empire lies a dimly faint light. The bright moon shines across the lands, for all eternity and with confidence. Their talks brings each other's heart gently closer.

character.bercouli_integrator_pc

Commander Bercouli Synthesis One, the 1st Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. While taking a break in the Great Bath of the Cathedral, Bercouli encounters the lone trespasser —Eugeo. Having heard that Eugeo had defeated his disciple Fanatio in battle, he aims his divine weapon, the Time-Splitting Sword, at the intruder. With a slash attack that is both powerful and can transcend time, Bercouli attacks using speed at the lone Eugeo.

character.cardinal_cathedral

A subprocess of the Cardinal System, the autonomous program that controls Underworld. Her duty is to correct errors made by the main process, Administrator, and she has spent 200 years in the Great Library of the Central Cathedral, observing and ruminating. She rescues Kirito and Eugeo when they are being pursued by an Integrity Knight, and reveals the secrets of Underworld to Kirito.

character.cardinal_cathedral_tsunagu

Cardinal once shared the same body as the Administrator and tried to delete the Administrator when she they were split, but failed. Having had escaped to the safety of the Great Library, she waited for an opportunity to present itself. Assisting Kirito and Eugeo in their battle against the Administrator, in order to fulfill her calling, she now stands at the very top of the Cathedral, armed with magic that has been honed for 200 years

character.dakira_integrator

A low-ranking Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She is a member of the Four Whirling Blades, who were personally trained by Fanatio. The four members, who are all identically equipped, attack using what is effectively a group combo skill. She has a crush on her leader, Fanatio, but is happy just to be near her, and keeps her emotions hidden deep down inside.

character.dakira_integrator_nohelmet

Dakira Synthesis Twenty-Two, the 22nd Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Having fallen into a forbidden love with her close friend, she carries with her a taboo past. After awaking as an Integrity Knight and being chosen as a member of the Four Whirling Blades, she sacrificed everything to Deputy Integrity Knight Commander Fanatio. As the Synthesis Ritual fogs her lost memories, a faint shadow envelopes within her. She hides away her love and affection behind the guise of reverence.

character.deusolbert_integrator_2022_march

A sharp pain pierced through my left arm unabated. What could it be? Then again, in comparison to the brave soldiers who sacrifice their lives for the safety of the Human Empire, this is nothing. These are sacrifices that can't be overlooked. In the end when there is nothing left, I will be sure to use this sword as an arrow...anything, so long as it means to annihilate the enemy.

character.diavel_sao

An SAO player. He uses a one-handed sword, and half-jokingly refers to himself as a "knight." He organizes the meeting before the 1st floor boss raid, and with his eloquent manner and shrewd leadership ability is able to put together a raid group made up of 44 of the top players in the game. Although his leadership qualities are genuine, he hides the fact that he was a former beta tester.

character.dil_2021_june

Dee Eye Ell, chancellor of the Dark Mages Guild. She is a being with extra-ordinary aspirations. In addition to eventually becoming the ruler of this world, she also has a peculiar view on life. She consumes the flesh of her allies in order to prolong her life, and the next target on her list happens to be the female swordsman from the other world. With her powers, D.I.L. will become unstoppable.

character.edith_2022_whiteday

It's pretty odd to have a set date on when to return the favor for a gift. Though, admittedly, it is a bit exciting waiting for that day to come. Alrighty! Let's try and pick out a gift - I wonder what gift will make her day?

character.edith_after_mc

So this is where they've been secretly building their minions, huh? My personality's been twisted because I've been with these things for so long. Or, on the contrary, maybe it's because my personality IS twisted that these things are always with me. Either or, it's time to tear this place apart.

character.edith_bath

Today was the day Eydis finally got her bath with Alice. Eydis would ask her about it every time they met, but Alice would always say no. Today, however, Eydis was finally able to convince her to give it a shot. And as Eydis sat on the ledge that lined the inside of the tub, carelessly tracing her feet around in the soothing water, she eventually looked up at Alice, who was standing next to her. Suddenly a wave of emotions, both of joy and sadness, overcame her. But having finally gotten what she'd always wanted, she decided to lock those complicated feelings away and simply enjoy the moment.

character.edith_darkside

As Eydis lifted up her sword above her head, darkness spread out in front of her. Deep in the darkness, a familiar voiced beckoned to her, calling her name. "Who is that...?" Whoever it is, she felt compelled to save them. Though she thought hard as to who this person could be, nobody sprang to mind. Regardless, she knew that she had to save them, whomever it may be. Even if it means cutting down whatever stands in her way.

character.edith_goddess

Illustration of Eydis in a goddess outfit to celebrate her birthday.

character.edith_integrator

Eydis Synthesis Ten, the 10th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Possessing the sacred treasure, "Dark Slash Sword" which was born from the depths of a lake where no light reaches, she stands out even amongst the Integrity Knights. She has an honest personality towards others, making her stick out from the other Integrity Knights who have more of a serious character. She treats Alice like a younger sister, much to the chagrin of Alice herself.

character.edith_integrator_2nd

Eydis in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Even if we were to say our goodbyes, you'll always have a place in my heart. I'll always be thinking of you!

character.edith_integrator_al

With her memories unlocked, the Dark Slash Sword spread darkness all around her. Because this darkness couldn't be controlled, she abstained from using it on the battlefield to avoid attacking her own allies. But when doing reconnaissance or fighting alone against many, she envelopes herself in darkness and demonstrates that effect to her heart's content. The war is not just on the front lines. Doing everything that she can in her role, Eydis pledges her body for the great war.

character.edith_integrator_al_2022_nov

Nothing has changed much in the 200 years since I became an Integrity Knight. Still, it was fun in its own way. But that changed when I met Alice. Alice came into my life, followed by Kirito and the others, and then Alice and I parted ways... However, I believe things will continue to change in the future. Until the day we meet again, I have to keep enjoying my life.

character.edith_integrator_al_wind

She took a deep breath of the fragrant flowers. With a slight breeze from the wind, the orange flowers quickly scattered and decorated her blonde hair. A slight smile formed on her face from this tranquil moment. Though she cannot stay for long, she enjoys her break before another mission beckons her away.

character.edith_integrator_init

The weather sure is nice! Eydis exclaims as she stretches out underneath the blue skies bathed in sunlight. In the gardens of the Cathedral, the smell of roses breeze through the winds accompanied by the soothing sounds of the water fountain. While reflecting on the good fortune of having a day off on such a beautiful day, Eydis laments that she could not spend this time together with Alice who is off far away on a mission.

character.edith_integrator_init_al

Eydis was completely focused on her training. Taking a deep breath, she stared up at the sky. The sun shone between the trees signaling that it was the afternoon already. As Eydis prepared to return back to her quarters, her hair had tussled into her view. Stopping in her tracks, she combed through her long hair and tied it back into a ponytail. "Appearances are also important". Walking again, her black hair elegantly swayed with every step she took.

character.edith_integrator_kizuna

Wherever Alice is, that's where Eydis would be. Now, she is nowhere to be found. As the assault on the Human Empire draws closer with every waking moment, Eydis has no time to reminiscence over the olden days. It's the day that Eydis predicted long ago; the day when the world that Alice loved needs her the most. Even today as she stares into the sky, Eydis continues to wait for her little sisters return.

character.edith_integrator_wounded_2021_oct

A burning sensation resonated deep within my right-eye as my head was struck with a pain that felt as if my head would crack open at any moment. Desperately clinging on to what little consciousness I had left, I gripped onto my sword which seemed to slip through my finger from the cold sweat. Although the girl said it was dangerous, I can't just submit to this pain. If it's to protect those who are precious to me, I don't care if I lose my right-eye or both for that matter. So I beg of you, lend me your strength. The one deep in my memories...the one dear to me.

character.edith_swimsuit

Forged from the heat of Solus, the waters of the lake around Eydis cooled her glowing skin. Comforted by this, she breathed a sigh of relief. Dipping her body into these waters and not the usual bath, is good from time to time. Even better when she finds herself with Alice.

character.edith_uw_2022_halloween

A special illustration to celebrate Halloween

character.edith_uw_2022_new_year

Though it may look like bread on the outside, it stretches out so much as soon as you put it in your mouth. What a bizarre snack! This soup is also so good, I think I might just get addicted to it! By the way, I wonder what "zoni" means in the Sacred Tongue? I'll have to ask Kirito later.

character.egome_soldier

An apprentice garrison guard in Zakkaria in Underworld. As a noble, he believes that he is free to do anything he wishes as long as it is not forbidden by law, as seen when he lets a greater swampfly loose at the city's west gate in order to make a horse run rampant. When he meets Kirito and Eugeo at the Swordsmanship Tournament he looks down on them, calling them "jobless and homeless." Before his match with Kirito, he bribes the sentinel in charge of distribution in order to get a better sword.

character.eldrie_integrator

Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-One, the 31st Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. He uses a divine object called the Frostscale Whip. On the orders of Alice, his mentor, he waits for Kirito and Eugeo in the Rose Garden when they escape from the underground prison. Although he tells them that he was summoned here from the heavens just a month ago, he was in fact the winner of the Four Empire Unification Tournament that same year, and when Eugeo points this out it throws him into a state of confusion.

character.entokia_integrator

Entokia Synthesis Eighteen, the 18th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Entokia was not able to participate in the war between the two worlds due to being sent to the Southern Empire. His divine weapon, the Roaring Thunder Spear, is a spear with a massive rectangular blade attached to it. It is a weapon created from a legendary beast that lived in the Southern Empire. Abnormally heavy, it is a weapon that even high ranking knights have a hard time lifting. Because of it's sheer size, it's not a weapon that people can carry and walk around the Cathedral with.

character.eugene_alo

An ALO player. He's the general of the Salamanders, and the younger brother of their current lord. In terms of combat ability alone he's said to be the strongest among all the Salamanders, and thus in all of ALO. He's also the owner of Demonic Sword Gram, a legendary weapon of which only one exists on the server. He launches an attack on the conference between the Sylph and Undine lords, leading to a heated battle between him and Kirito.

character.eugeo_cathedral

A swordsman originally from Rulid Village in Underworld. He is imprisoned in the Central Cathedral for breaking the laws of the Taboo Index, but escapes. He learns the Perfect Weapon Control art from Cardinal, and recovers his sword—the "Blue Rose Sword"—from the armory. In order to rescue his childhood friend Alice, who has lost her memories and became an Integrity Knight, he heads for the top floor of the Central Cathedral to face Administrator.

character.eugeo_cathedral_al

In order to return the lost memories of the Integrity Knight Alice, Eugeo climbed up to the Cloudtop Garden on the 80th floor of Central Cathedral to reunite with her. Leaning on the Osmanthus tree, Eugeo closed his eyes and in that moment, memories of his childhood came flooding back. Although he is at a loss for words when aiming his sword at Alice, betting on a sliver of hope he had gotten from the Cardinal, together with Kirito, they faced off against Alice.

character.eugeo_cathedral_enhance

On the 50th floor of the Cathedral, in the midst of the confrontation between Kirito and the Integrity Knight Fanatio Synthesis Two, Eugeo secretly waited in the light of the corridor for the Perfect Weapon Control art to begin casting. When Fanatio was to use her Divine Weapon, Heaven Piercing Sword's Memory Release, that was to be the moment when Eugeo would use the Perfect Weapon Control art. With icicles blanketing the corridor, Fanatio's movements stopped. "Bloom! Blue Rose!"

character.eugeo_cathedral_recollection

In the End Mountains to the north resides the divine weapon, the Blue Rose Sword, born out of the eternal ice and a blue rose. Having long thought of being the stuff of legends, the sword released Eugeo from his Calling as a carver and set him off on a journey to rescue Alice. The sword's presence continued to support Eugeo on his journey. Like Kirito, it is his companion.

character.eugeo_child_2020may

Carver of the Gigas Cedar, Eugeo of Rulid Village. One day, to send off a sick Alice, Eugeo and his close friend Kirito headed into the forest to get apples. Clinging onto the trunk of the tree, Eugeo was afraid at first, but his fears quickly evaporated with the voice of Kirito calling out to him at the bottom of the tree. Before he knew it, Eugeo had climbed up to a pretty high position. Looking over at the delicious looking red fruit in front of him, a smile forms on Eugeo's face.

character.eugeo_contest

This is the costume that won the SAO Alicization Rising Steel Original Costume Design Contest held in June, 2020. It's an Astrologer's costume with a motif based on the Altair constellation.

character.eugeo_halloween

Limited Edition Spooky Halloween Night Scout Illustration

character.eugeo_integrator

Eugeo Synthesis Thirty-Two , the 32nd Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Emboldened by the new module model, Eugeo stands in front of Kirito and Alice, now being able to use the power of Incarnate after the Synthesis Ritual. With his sights set on Kirito、Eugeo opens his attack with a different skill from the Aincrad style —a skill he learned at the Swordcraft Academy.

character.eugeo_integrator_2nd

Eugeo in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. I'm happy to have you by my side. Thank you always.

character.eugeo_trainee2nd_date

I wonder if she's ok with me joining? Eugeo ponders with worry as he waits for the person who invited him. However, those worries quickly evaporated upon seeing the person's cheery expression on her face as she closed in on Eugeo while also trying to catch her breath. "Are you ok? You didn't have to rush over here, you're still pretty early!" Eugeo couldn't help smiling and held out his hand.

character.eugeo_uw_2022_new_year_f

So in this game, the other player should try to immediately hit the shuttle with the wooden paddle before it hits the ground. This so called "shuttle" training is harder than it looks. Compared to sword training, this requires quick reflexes on top of muscle. The odds can change at a moments notice...So I'll go on the offensive to make sure that Kirito's face gets sprayed with ink!

character.eugeo_woodcutter

A resident of Rulid Village in Underworld. He has been assigned the Calling of “carver," and must swing his axe 2,000 times in 1 day to try and fell a giant pitch-black tree known as the Gigas Cedar. He is the first person Kirito meets when he arrives in Underworld, and from that point on they become companions. When he was a child, his friend Alice was taken away by an Integrity Knight, and to this day he still regrets not having been able to save her.

character.fanatio_integrator

Fanatio Synthesis Two, the deputy leader of the Integrity Knights of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She leads the Four Whirling Blades, and wields the Heaven Piercing Sword, a divine weapon that can unleash a beam of light powerful enough to melt marble. She hides her face with her helmet so that people do not look down on her for being a woman. When Kirito still does not hold back after learning that she is female, a no-holds-barred battle commences.

character.fizel_integrator_apprentice

Fizel Synthesis Twenty-Nine, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She was part of a group of children who were used as guinea pigs for the "Resurrection" Sacred Art experiments, in which their Calling was to repeatedly kill each other. She and Linel were the last survivors, and a special exception was made in order to allow them to become Integrity Knights. However, the two of them are fed up with being forced to undertake the daily training that comes with being an apprentice Integrity Knight.

character.fizel_integrator_apprentice_plate

Fizel Synthesis Twenty-Nine, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She received her number and became an apprentice Integrity Knight due to a special case. She tried to corner Kirito and Eugeo with her sword forged from Ruberyl's poisoned steel, however it failed with Kirito's counterattack. They thought Kirito was being too easy on them, but his actions began to stir some kind of feeling inside them.

character.frenica_trainee1st

A Novice Trainee at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. According to Tiese, her roommate at the dorm, she is "a great girl—hardworking and diligent, and very humble, despite her skill with a sword." She is selected as page by Humbert, who continually gives her inappropriate orders, causing her great distress. Unable to stand by and let this continue, Tiese and Ronie ask Eugeo and Kirito for help.

character.golgorosso_trainee2nd

An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. His position as Third-Seat Elite Disciple is unchallenged. He boasts a body like tempered steel, and uses a formidable single-hit-knockout sword style known as Baltio Style. He selects Eugeo, who like him is a commoner and former guard, as his page. As well as sword techniques, he teaches him the importance of mental fortitude to a swordsman.

character.humbert_trainee2nd

An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. A high-ranking noble from a fourth-rank noble family, he's the Second-Seat Elite Disciple in Kirito and Eugeo's year, and is Raios's friend turned sidekick. He's an unpleasant character, but has been specially trained in the High-Norkian Style since a young age, and his skill with a sword is no joke. When his duel with Eugeo—who he despises as a commoner—ends in a draw, he takes his anger out on his own page, Frenica.

character.iskahn

Iskahn, the boxing champion of the Dark Territory in Underworld. As the Dark Territory forces advances towards the Human Empire's army, Iskahn engages in battle against the Integrity Knight Sheyta who's come to buy the Human Empire time. Upon realizing that his allies were deliberately wounded, his anger reaches a boiling point. "I'm going to make you pay!" He shouts, as he slams his body, hardened with Incarnate, against her armor, breaking it. He challenges the wielder of the divine weapon, Black Lily Sword, with his bare fists.

character.iskahn_mc_2021_sep

After the war had ended, the world around us quickly changed. My circumstances as well as those of everyone in the Dark Territory had changed dramatically compared to just a short while ago. No matter what obstacles await us from this point forward, my fists will be ready to deal with them. For this world, for my family, and the siblings I swear to protect, I will lead them to a brighter future.

character.iskahn_one_eye

It felt as if the fire within him had smoldered. He asked himself, who and what was he fighting for? For him, there was only one reason - his friends. Though the pain from his crushed right eye resonated, his heart held steady. Not wanting to hold back his allies, Iskahn the boxer pressed forward against the red guards in front of him.

character.kagemune_alo

An ALO player. He is captain of the Salamanders' Lance Squad. He is a magic-warrior, and as well as his lance also makes use of everything from fire-elemental attack magic to the Searching skill. He is renowned for his Sylph-hunting ability; by combining a well-timed ambush with an attack formation using heavy armor and relentless charging lance attacks, he forces even Leafa's veteran player-packed party to retreat.

character.kibaou_sao

A SAO player. He plays a cactus-haired swordsman who uses a one-handed sword. At the meeting before the 1st floor boss raid, he angrily blames the beta testers for the deaths of 2,000 players in a single month. He later forms the Aincrad Liberation Squad with the aim of distributing resources as fairly as possible.

character.kibaou_sao_2021_oct

Finally! After having started a month ago, we've finally reached the boss. If we can clear the first floor, then there's hope yet that we can escape from this death game. But before we get to that, there's still one thing I need to take care of before dealing with the boss. Those who abandoned us when we were just newbies, the ones who monopolize the best hunting grounds and the best quests, those damn beta testers.

character.kirito_after_mc

Although I couldn't return back to the real world, there are people in this world who need me. So long as Asuna remains by my side, I can overcome whatever obstacles there are.

character.kirito_alo_aprilfool

Why do people fight? Over territory? Queens? Last attack bonuses? It's because these things have no owners... yet. If I were to control all of these, then the fighting will cease, and a true peace will descend upon this world.

character.kirito_alo_ca

Overhearing news that the legendary weapon "Holy Sword Excalibur" had been discovered in ALO, Kazuto and Suguha headed to Jötunheimr with their party members to take on the quest to obtain the weapon. Holding a Sword in each hand, Kazuto slices through Powerful Enemies with his Skill Connect by alternating between Sword Skills. Just like in his days in SAO, Kazuto shows off his Two-sword Style technique.

character.kirito_cathedral

An "unregistered unit" who found himself in Underworld. He is imprisoned in the Central Cathedral for violating the Taboo Index by harming the life of another, but escapes. He is rescued by Cardinal, and learns how this world came into existence. In order to defeat Administrator, he learns the Perfect Weapon Control art and recovers his sword—"The Black One"—from the armory.

character.kirito_cathedral_enhance

Standing at the highest floor of the Cathedral, Kirito tracked down the Administrator after the sacrifice of his friends. However, the Administrator was able to pick out all of Kirito's sword skills and he was not able to land a single strike. On his knees, Kirito was entrusted with the Red Rose Sword; born from the Blue Rose Sword and the body of Eugeo. Wielding the Night Sky Sword in his right-hand and the Red Rose Sword on his left, Kirito dual wields both swords to challenge the Administrator once more.

character.kirito_cathedral_mission

Kirito carried Alice, who believed in him even after losing her eye from breaking the seal, on his back as he scaled the outer walls of the Cathedral. However, waiting for them in the Morning Star Lookout on the 95th floor was the Integrity Knight Eydis. Though the rebel Kirito warranted more than enough of a reason for Eydis to fight, it was inevitable when she saw the wounded Alice, whom Eydis loved like a sister.

character.kirito_ggo_man

Jumping onto GGO to investigate the "Death Gun Incident", even in a world where guns and steel dominate, Kirito selects the Photon sword as his main weapon. He is able to use his battle experiences which he cultivated from SAO/ALO to predict an enemy's line of fire and pull off amazing feats like fire bullets with his Photon sword. Fighting side by side with Sinon, he settles his connection with Death Gun.

character.kirito_ggo_wizard

2.5-Year Anniversary Design! - Original concept by Yoshitsugu Matsuoka "Kirito the Witch" -

character.kirito_integrator

Limit Break Character Illustration - illust：abec

character.kirito_mc

Post-war life continues for Kirito down in the Underworld. Even though his position as the Human Unification Council's Swordsman Delegate has made it difficult for him to venture out freely, he still manages to slip out from the Cathedral from time to time to watch over the town and it's people.

character.kirito_mc_2021_may

It's not easy being the Swordsman Delegate. There are probably many out there who think the same. Even now, Kirito could feel the unshakable feeling of someone stabbing him in the back at any given moment. If there was ever the possibility to solve problems without drawing our swords it would be great, but that doesn't seem to be the case here. The faint sound of pebbles being lightly crushed into one another alert Kirito of an incoming presence. He draws his sword and turns to face it. "I don't know who you are...but if you have any business with me then it's best you show yourself. I'm always ready for a fight."

character.kirito_os

Kirito distances himself from the popular MMORPG (Ordinal Scale) which uses the AR device (Augma). However, realizing that the cause for the abnormalities happening in Asuna's body was caused by Ordinal Scale, Kirito picks up the sword again in the world of Ordinal Scale in order to find the truth behind the targeting of SAO survivors.

character.kirito_sao_2nd_anniv

Kirito in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for your continued support. Your support is what keeps us going. Here's to more adventures to come.

character.kirito_sao_4

A SAO player. Clad all in black, he uses a one-handed sword and no shield. Even among the members of the front-line Assault Team, he's highly respected for his combat ability, and despite being a solo player has mapped more unexplored Labyrinth areas than many entire guilds have. The guild he was once aligned with was completely wiped out, and because of this traumatic experience he avoids working together with others.

character.kirito_sao_2021_sep

Telling her directly that it was odd seeing her here would have attracted the unwanted ire of the shop owner... Despite the risks, it was hard not to see that someone like her stick out even in the packed store. She wore a white and red uniform with hair stretching all the way down to her waist...and hazelnut eyes that seemed to be looking in my direction. Nervously, I averted my gaze.

character.kirito_sao_al_dualblade

Trying to buy time until Asuna and Alice arrives at the World's End Altar, Kirito took on the black-cloaked nihilistic Gabriel in a heated battle. With each one of his attacks being absorbed, Kirito is overwhelmed by the sheer power before him and it seems as those his consciousness might be dragged back into the darkness. But in that moment, a faint warmth enveloped his left hand and a familiar voice beckoned him back from the abyss.

character.kirito_sao_black_sword

Once upon a time, there was a world where I fought for my life with a sword in hand. A world in a game, but not to be enjoyed. Above all, it's the world where she saved my life. She's been by my side ever since. A lot has happened since then, but that's the one thing that I'm sure won't change. No matter how difficult the path ahead may be, we can overcome anything as long as we're together.

character.kirito_sao_couple_dualblade

Kirito and Asuna discovered the boss room on the 74th floor. Just as quickly as they opened the intimidating door to check on the boss, the two withdraw with all their speed. On the other hand, the Aincrad Liberation Force, who had attacked the boss were blocking the entrance, leaving them in a dire situation. Asuna then rushes to the rescue, followed by Kirito. Resolving that they will be wiped out at this rate, Kirito grips on to his Elucidator on his right hand and the Dark Repulser on the left, confronting the boss with an extra skill that no one has ever seen before.

character.kirito_sao_final_gold_dualblade

Everyone looked towards the night sky and prayed. For the safety over their loved ones and for peace to return once more to the world. Each one of these wishes become another tiny star that brightens up the night sky. Armed with dual blades containing the collected wishes of this world, Kirito presses forward to the last battle.

character.kirito_sao_progre_1st_coat

It was just like a flash of light. With every flick of her rapier, enemies toppled over where they stood. I stood and admired over the speed and accuracy of her attacks, but in the heat of battle I could tell that she was reaching her limits. Even though I knew she didn't want me to, I called out to her.

character.kirito_sao_recollection_dualblade

At the end of the life or death struggle with the Administrator, the ones who woke up the unconscious Kirito was the talented engineer Higa with his last minute actions, and those who dived into the world with the same STL who all carried a deep bond with Kirito. Then there was the spirit of Eugeo who was become deeply attached within Kirito. Being able to stand up again, Kirito wields both his own sword and that of his fallen companion who saved him on countless occasions. He lives to save countless souls.

character.kirito_sao_wasureji

Long ago, there was a young boy imprisoned in the floating castle for 2 years who carried countless angst on his own shoulders. He experienced untold amounts of greetings and goodbyes. Like a collar that wouldn't come off. Despite this, Kirito had a reason for overcoming the many hurdles that stood in his way in this world. The time of spending days with the love of his life were beginning to come to shape for Kirito.

character.kirito_saop_2022_movie

It might only cause her trouble to be around me. That's something I worry about from time to time, even being here on the fifth floor. But I've already made up my mind. I'll continue to protect her with my life until she's strong enough that she doesn't need me anymore.

character.kirito_tales

When I don this outfit, I can already feel my fists get stronger. Using a martial arts skill with this is surely to release something powerful. Although there was someone out there with a similar voice to me who also wore this, I wonder what kind of person they were? Someday, I hope I can meet that person.

character.kirito_woodcutter

A young boy who awakes to find himself in a virtual world known as Underworld (UW). He still has his real-world consciousness and memories, which are usually blocked during dives, but has lost his memories from immediately prior to arriving in this virtual world. Realizing that the residents of UW are neither humans nor AI, he heads to Centoria in order to ascertain the reason behind this, as well as what his own mission is.

character.klein_alo

Klein shivered as cold air wrapped around his body. Completing quests is important, but for Klein, working together with everyone was more fun than anything else. But his meeting with this female NPC changed everything...his soulmate. Klein felt that saving her was his calling. Trusting his feelings, Klein gripped his sword.

character.klein_alo_2022_new_year

I'm really happy to be able to welcome the new year with everyone! I hope this year will be both safe and fun...with no funny business! Then again, there's really only one person here that I need to worry about... Anyways, cheers!

character.klein_sao_3

A SAO player. He uses a katana, and is easily recognizable by his spiky red hair and gaudy bandanas. He's the leader of Fuurinkazan, a guild he formed together with his friends, who he helped level up to the point that they were all included in the Assault Team. He's been friends with Kirito since before the official release of SAO, and is a strong supporter of his. He worries about Kirito, and sometimes tries to caution him.

character.kuradeel_sao

A SAO player. He is a member of the Knights of the Blood guild. He was assigned as Asuna's personal guard, and displays an unusual attachment to her. He oversteps the mark on several occasions, such as by secretly staking out her apartment. He despises Kirito, who grows closer to Asuna by the day, and challenges him to a duel but loses. When dismissed from his position as personal guard, his hatred grows even stronger.

character.leafa_alo

An ALO player. Her speed and skill with a sword make her one of the 5 strongest Sylphs. When attacked by Salamanders in the Legrue Corridor, at Kirito's behest she takes on the role of healer, though she is not used to doing so. Facing a flawless defense and endless onslaught of attacks, she prepares herself for death, but is then deeply touched by Kirito's determination to go on living.

character.leafa_alo_2nd_anniv

Leafa in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. Thank you for always being there! Whether good or bad times, we'll always have each other!

character.leafa_alo_2020_new_year

Long ago, there lived a girl who devoted her whole life to kendo. Due to circumstances, she descended into the world of MMORPG which she despised, and gained invaluable experiences and friends. Trading in her sword for the brush at the start of the year, she wears a polished traditional Japanese outfit. Leafa's wish is to paint the skies of the Land of the Fairies during daybreak and paint a new beginning. Happiness has come!

character.leafa_alo_2022_yukata

Look over there! There's so many fireworks! They're so beautiful... I bet if we were closer it would be even better... Hey... I have an idea! How about we do that? Just... the two of us.

character.leafa_alo_al

She was sound asleep, but the bright lights cascading down overhead woke her up. Stretching out her back, the flowers around her rustled in the wind as if smiling at her. This spot was high up from the ground with branches blocking the view. Like a small room just for her, this place was one of her favorite spots.

character.leafa_alo_idol

Never in my wildest dreams did I think that I would be performing a live concert. But, contrary to my thoughts, singing is the one thing that brightens up my mood. Afterall, singing while flying isn't exactly an easy thing to do in the real world. Performing with magic could be fun...I just need to be sure not to make this into a habit.

character.leafa_alo_init

An ALO player. She plays a Sylph magic-swordsman. Known as the "Speedaholic," she is obsessed with flying, and thanks to her many years of kendo training is recognized as one of the five strongest Sylphs. Her initial foray into virtual worlds was an attempt to get closer to her brother, who was trapped inside SAO. She offered to travel to the World Tree together with Kirito, without knowing that he was in fact her brother.

character.leafa_alo_pajamas

Tonight's the long awaited pajama party. Wearing the cute outfit that she's prepared for the occasion, Leafa finished decorating the walls of the room and gently laid down on the large bed, lost in her thoughts. "I wonder what we should talk about today?" Any conversations involving only girls are bound to be something truly special.

character.leafa_alo_swim

Leafa's felt a jolt of nervousness as the lifebuoy wobbled uncontrollably. "Relax! It won't wobble if you do!" she could hear from her brother, but if it was that easy she wouldn't find herself in this predicament. "Hold me!" she exclaims as she grabbed onto her brother's arm.

character.leafa_os

The AR (Augmented Reality) Type Information Terminal "Augma" is extremely popular and linked with point system that can be used in the real world. Suguha also loved to use this device with the MMORPG, Ordinal Scale, where she could use her strength and skills she learned from kendo. "It's so much fun actually moving your body to play the game!" Like always, Suguha logs in to swing her sword in the game world.

character.leafa_os_swim

Let's get swimming lessons! they said as Leafa went to the nearby pool. Although she wants to be able to swim, just the thought of going into the water is enough to make Leafa freeze up in her tracks. Clutching onto her brother, she holds onto him not out of embarrassment—but to keep herself from drowning.

character.leafa_tales

Although I've never worn such an outfit before, but it's actually not so bad. Instead of fighting with swords, it's nice to support Kirito with my magic from time to time!

character.leafa_terraria

On a midsummer night, upon receiving a message from Yui, Suguha takes a taxi to Rath offices in Roppongi where she met up with Shino. Together, the two logged into Underworld with accounts prepared by Rath. Asuna as the Goddess of Creation, Sinon as the Sun Goddess Solus, and now Leafa as Goddess of Earth Terraria, Leafa joins Asuna and the others as they venture out to save their one and only Kirito.

character.leafa_terraria_2021_june

Leafa couldn't move an inch as the disgusting tentacle touched her body. Even virtually, this was something she never wanted to actually experience. But she mustn't give up. Human or not, Leafa vows to crush the enemy in front of her!

character.leafa_terraria_al

Leafa descended down into the Underworld as "Mother Earth Terraria". She had no knowledge of the people and places of the Underworld, but what she saw and the conversations she had would tell her all she needs to know. Only her own sense of justice decides where she aims her sword. A source of hope in a world stained with blood.

character.leafa_terraria_enhance

Leafa, now the Goddess of Earth, freely raced through the forests. Things like undergrowth and fallen tree that would usually hamper people didn't matter to Leafa anymore. Moving forward elegantly, Leafa pressed on deeper into the forest. By chance, she pauses, and peering at the streams of light passing through the crevices of the trees, she stumbles upon a hidden sight. Sitting down for a brief moment, Leafa looks on with satisfaction at the beautiful scenery in front of her.

character.leafa_ur

The coast was all clear. Leafa quickly slipped out of the forest while checking the perimeter around the log house where everyone had made their new base of operations. Although she was perplexed by the world that she suddenly found herself in, Leafa found solace around the company of her friends. It was the start of a whole new adventure for Leafa...And the thrill of it all resonated deep within her.

character.linel_integrator_apprentice

Linel Synthesis Twenty-Eight, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She was part of a group of children who were used as guinea pigs for the "Resurrection" Sacred Art experiments, in which their Calling was to repeatedly kill each other. She and Fizel were the last survivors, and a special exception was made in order to allow them to become Integrity Knights. However, the two of them are fed up with being forced to undertake the daily training that comes with being an apprentice Integrity Knight.

character.linel_integrator_apprentice_plate

Linel Synthesis Twenty-Eight, an apprentice Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. She intended to execute the Central Cathedral fugitive Kirito, but thanks to his quick wit her plan ended in failure. When Kirito said, "Sword arts aren't all I'm good at," the world she viewed as to kill or be killed was greatly shook.

character.lisbeth_alo_2022_new_year

Since it's the Year of the Tiger, I decided to wear this tiger-striped outerwear...and it's surprisingly warm! With this, I should be able to collect material in the snow mountains with ease. Plus, I'm staking out my honor as a master smith to win that new year's kite-flying match! There's no way I can lose!

character.lisbeth_alo_init

An ALO player. She played a blacksmith in SAO, and again chose to become a Leprechaun blacksmith in ALO. She runs Lisbeth Armory on the main street of Yggdrasil City, and is responsible for maintaining the equipment of Kirito and the others. She is best friends with Asuna. Although her race makes her ill-suited to combat, her curiosity as a mace user made her duel with the Absolute Sword.

character.lisbeth_alo_mace

Like any other day, Lisbeth prepares to open up her weapons shop in ALO. Gazing up, Lisbeth is instantly captivated by the surrounding blue skies. Wanting to relax a little before starting work for the day, she takes off into the vast skies above her. "You can't experience this feeling anywhere but in ALO." Lisbeth gradually rises faster and faster into the far reaches of the sky. Bathed in streaming light, Lisbeth finds satisfaction walking among the clouds.

character.lisbeth_alo_pajamas

How about a Tea Party? Rika said, calling out to Shino and the others. "This time is girls only!" Rika added next, shooting down Asuna's suggestion for Kirito to come. "If that's the case, then how about a pajama party?" suggested Keiko. Logging in to ALO, they begin their girls' night dressed in nightgowns chatting away late into the night.

character.lisbeth_alo_swim

Packed with their new swimsuits, a large lifebuoy, and all preparations done, Lisbeth and the others went to the beach. "Let's jump in!" They exclaimed as they left their luggage in one spot, and jumped into the ocean. Playing volleyball and splashing around in the ocean, Lisbeth continued playing around until she got tired. Riding on the lifebuoy in the end, Lisbeth gazes up at the blue sky as the waves cradle her, satisfied with the day she just had.

character.lisbeth_sao_anniv

Lisbeth's 2.5-Year Anniversary Outfit: "Breeding isn't something you can do by yourself you know! We need people who can fight like you guys! And as long as you guys are around, I will continue to help you out."

character.medina_lycoris

Noble daughter of the 9th head of the Orthinanos family, second class noble family. Originally a calm and mild tempered girl, when it comes to battle she quickly changes into another person. To win back the honor of the Orthinanos family name, she lives to get stronger and distinguish herself in the field of battle.

character.mito_sao

Still unfamiliar with the game, I showed the girl around the town. It was cute seeing the expression on her face as she absorbed her surroundings. In the real world, never would I have dreamed that I would go shopping with a girl... So I swore to myself, that no matter what, we would survive to do just that in the real world.

character.mito_saop_2022_movie

To think I'd end up dueling with Asuna in SAO. I'm no longer an Assault Team member, so I don't have enough strength to fight on the front lines. Still, it's strange. For some reason, crossing swords with her seems to be erasing all the regrets and worries that have occupied my mine for so long. It must be thanks to her...Asuna.

character.nergius_integrator

Nergius Synthesis Sixteen, the 16th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Having been faithful to the Administrator, Nergius still harbors resentment against the Swordsman Delegate, Kirito of the Human Empire Unification Council. With his divine weapon, Budding Storm Spear in hand, today Nergius and his steady demeanor takes aim at the Swordsman Delegate once more.

character.phillia_sao

An original character from the game, "Sword Art Online: Hollow Fragment", she is a SAO survivor. Earning the nickname "Treasure Hunter", she revels in seeking out treasure chests. She met Kirito in the Hollow Area in SAO.

character.rain_alo

An original character who appeared in the game, Sword Art Online: Lost Song. Rain is a blacksmith fairy (Leprechaun) who fought alongside Kirito and his party in ALO. She uses a two-sword style like Kirito, but if you ask her, she'd tell you it's actually a "multi-sword style". She's also one of the very few players in all of ALO who possess the rare OSS.

character.raios_trainee2nd

An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. He is the eldest child of a third-rank noble family, and the First-Seat Elite Disciple in Kirito and Eugeo's year. He holds commoners and low-ranking nobles in great contempt, and takes every opportunity he can to show it. He's arrogant and spiteful, but his enormous conceit seems to be a source of strength, and his skills with a sword are a cut above those of the other students from noble backgrounds.

character.renri_integrator

Renly Synthesis Twenty Seven, the 27th Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church in Underworld. Although he doesn't have any memories, he was an extraordinary young prodigy swordsman. After the Synthesis Ritual, he lost confidence when he could not properly wield the divine object: Twin Edged Wings.
